observations: Metallic frame with two mounting brackets at the top and bottom.
Vertical finned core with visible surface grime and residue.
Watermark 'FAMOUS AUTO PARTS' is visible across the center.
The item is resting on a wooden surface in what appears to be a workshop or garage.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The item may be a generic or used part rather than a genuine OEM part.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the frame or core).

risks.risk: The internal cooling fins may be severely damaged or blocked by grime.
risks.proof: A video showing a thermometer reading the temperature of the air exiting the unit.

risks.risk: The compressor or refrigerant lines may be leaking or missing.
risks.proof: A video of a refrigerant leak test (soapy water on the lines).
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full compressor replacement

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the brand and part number.
Photo of the compressor and refrigerant lines.
Video of the unit plugged in and running to check for noise and cooling.
response.reason: The item is a standard used automotive part. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a generic used unit, pending verification of the brand and functional state.
